title: Characterization of $\mathfrak{k}$-highest weight and $\widehat{\mathfrak{g}}$-dominant tableaux via $1$-$0$-slack recording tableaux in the quantum Littlewood-Richardson rule and lattice points in flagged hive polytopes
summary: We have previously, for a given positive integer $n$, explicitly characterized by certain linear inequalities the $\mathfrak{k}$-highest weight tableaux of shape length $2n$ or $2n-1$ produced by $1$-$0$-slack recording tableaux in the quantum Littlewood-Richardson (LR) rule. We now extend that characterization for lower shape lengths.
